title.en: UCI BLE RSSI (Waldo library), random 80/20 split of the 1,420 labelled scans, seed 0; grid cells
title.zh: UCI BLE RSSI（Waldo 图书馆），1,420 条有标签样本随机 80/20 划分，种子 0；单位为网格

dataset.name: ble_rssi_uci
dataset.pos_units: grid cells of the source map (column letter A=1, row number counted downward); cell size not stated
dataset.citation: Mohammadi, Al-Fuqaha, Guizani, Oh, Semisupervised Deep Reinforcement Learning in Support of IoT and Smart City Services, IEEE Internet of Things Journal 5(2), 2018

protocol.name: random-80-20
protocol.summary: uniformly random 80 % train / 20 % test rows (seeded; optimistic for fingerprinting)

tables.units: grid cells of the source map (column letter A=1, row number counted downward); cell size not stated

skips.en: the beacon positions are given only as a map image, not as coordinates
skips.zh: 信标位置只以地图图片给出，没有坐标

notes.en: Errors are in grid cells of the map shipped with the data (the cell size is not stated). Consecutive scans at one cell are near duplicates, so a random split is optimistic. The 5,191 unlabelled scans are not used.
notes.zh: 误差单位为数据附带地图的网格（未给出网格尺寸）。同一网格的连续扫描几乎重复，随机划分偏乐观。未使用 5,191 条无标签样本。
